correctness.rationale: The beta moments give the specified positive normalizer. The left endpoint factor is never zero. The right endpoint vanishes only at (rho,delta)=(0,1), where absorbing (1-x)^2 adds exactly two to the right shape. After this reduction, equality of endpoint orders fixes alpha and the canonical right shape b; the factor with constant term one is then uniquely fixed. For its nonzero linear/quadratic coefficients p,q, delta=-2q/p and rho=4q/p^2-1. A constant factor gives exactly the reported beta fibers, including the strict cutoff b>2. Density zeros inside the interval do not affect this argument. At rho>0, delta=0 the rho score vanishes, and the other scores are multiples of centered log(x), log(1-x), x. A putative constant linear combination, differentiated and multiplied by x(1-x), has all three coefficients zero. The scores are square integrable, so this proves the exact Gram rank. Identical laws at every sample size give the stated consistency obstruction. The frozen SymPy checker was inspected, not executed; its algebraic checks do not prove exhaustiveness or Fisher rank.
residual_risks: No unconstrained information-rank assertion is made at the boundary rho=0.
